P01.rationale: No founder portrait or human anchor appears anywhere on this page; it is entirely text and layout.

P05.rationale: There are no case study portraits at all — the page contains only headings, body text, and a footer placeholder.

P10.rationale: No oversized decorative typographic elements like ghost numerals or large quote glyphs are used — typography is purely functional.

P11.rationale: There are no data visualisations bound to numbers; the page contains only textual content without charts, graphs, or cost-math.

P12.rationale: The page reads as dense and magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with structured text blocks and clear hierarchy.

P13.rationale: The background is flat blankness — no intentional texture or atmosphere appropriate to a consulting report is applied.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion for treating overlaid text readability does not apply — but since there’s no image, it scores zero by default.

P16.rationale: No device/product mockup (phone/laptop/book) is shown; the page contains only typographic and layout elements without product imagery.

N07.rationale: Imagery is absent entirely — no stock or specific business visuals exist to evaluate for genericity.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the page is densely filled with text blocks and structured sections leaving little empty region.

N10.rationale: No text sits on a busy photo or awkward inset gap — there are no photos at all to create such issues.
